independent_review.scope: new real P2P signaling, engine, capture UI and deployment diffs; no corporate sources

findings.issue: P2P backend accepted participant/bitrate settings that ready-frame client rejects
findings.resolution: Config now validates2..12 peers and500000..32000000bps with boundary tests

verified_by_inspection: Strict signed token admission and same-user/same-session reauthentication; monotonic version allowance confined to already admitted socket
Fresh permissions, membership, session revocation, disable, expiry and moderation checks; timeout is fail-closed
Server-owned connection identities and same-channel recipient checks; no arbitrary client sender identity
Bounded incoming frame size, rate, SDP/ICE, global peers, room peers and outbound queues; no SDP/ICE/token persistence in new path
UI captures only after explicit actions, pending capture ownership/generations are invalidated by close or revocation, source preview is stopped on cancel
Four ordered media slots, source-kind/mid validation, authoritative roster gates, loss of signaling stops local tracks and remote peer connections
P2P default does not require LiveKit; optional sfu profile preserves fallback and backups account for optional services
CI isolates new P2P database and mode from existing LiveKit regression environment
P2P media mode short-circuits LiveKit RPC reconciliation, revoke and token/admission routes, including leftover credentials
Per-peer invalid SDP fails that peer only; authority rosters are processed without waiting for a slow peer negotiation
UI screen-audio checkbox is respected at publication and pending microphone tracks follow deafen changes
limitations: Two cooperating modified peers can retain already established direct media; this server does not provide central cryptographic revocation
No TURN means some NAT/firewall combinations cannot connect
This review does not establish physical Windows/WebView2 compatibility, hardware capture, or external network latency
